title: Duskmourn: House of Horror: card flavor text

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane that is a vast, shifting House of horrors inhabited by monsters and survivors.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The malevolent ruler of Duskmourn who whispers to those inside, craves fear and pain, and harbors loathing for dogs.

entities.name: Valgavoth's Ascension
entities.description: The event before which the souls of the dead exist only as fractured echoes.

entities.name: Lord of Pain
entities.description: A being who urges others to hunt and entertain it.

entities.name: Floodpits
entities.description: A region of Duskmourn where survivors hear their own drowning voices.

entities.name: Hauntwoods
entities.description: A region of Duskmourn where life follows its own laws.

entities.name: Boilerbilges
entities.description: A region of Duskmourn that twitches like a trapped animal.

entities.name: Balemurk
entities.description: A region of Duskmourn that spits and boils.

entities.name: Mistmoors
entities.description: A region of Duskmourn whose fields are drowned by deluge.

entities.name: Valgavoth's Lair
entities.description: The one chamber in the House whose location never changes, the heart of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Vendrell house
entities.description: The original house the Ghostly Keybearer once watched over before the House expanded.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Monstrous inhabitants of Duskmourn whose only hobby is murder.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Monsters of Valgavoth that hordes of survivors fight.

entities.name: Glimmers
entities.description: Physical manifestations of survivors' hope and courage that protect against Valgavoth's influence.

entities.name: Beasties
entities.description: Masked creatures of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Linette
entities.description: A survivor who strode forth to face Duskmourn's terrors without fear.

entities.name: Garden
entities.description: A survivor technologist.

entities.name: Nina
entities.description: A person frozen in fear as a monster approached.

entities.name: Marcus
entities.description: A ghost who had been a devoted guide of new arrivals in life.

entities.name: Rian
entities.description: A former survivor who urges splitting up.

entities.name: Toby
entities.description: A child who is not scared because Gribble is big.

entities.name: Gribble
entities.description: Toby's large companion.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A survivor who warns of Valgavoth's eyes and who bargains his way out.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who kept silent in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: A planeswalker whose blade brought the light of another plane into Duskmourn and who was taken into the House's maw.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker in Duskmourn who explores with allies.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: A student with a theory of fractalization and a nervous dreamer.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A planeswalker who punches cultists and mocks wickerfolk.

entities.name: Niko
entities.description: A companion of the Wanderer who shattered wickerfolk and saved Nashi.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A person whisked to safety by Niko.

entities.name: Tyson
entities.description: A victim whose lungs unraveled as he tried to scream.

entities.name: Jakob
entities.description: A victim who fell for months.

entities.name: Tino
entities.description: A person separated from his friends.

entities.name: Sasha
entities.description: A survivor who fought cellarspawn with her childhood pet hamster's essence.

entities.name: Harp
entities.description: A survivor who sent his glimmer into the dark.

entities.name: Joseph
entities.description: A comedian who spoke last words.

entities.name: Elsa
entities.description: A person who bargained with a demon.

entities.name: Tarvin
entities.description: A survivor with a cracked skull.

entities.name: Marina
entities.description: A person to whom Valgavoth whispered.

entities.name: Torain
entities.description: A slayer who had never lost a match.

entities.name: Norin
entities.description: A survivor who fled without finding out what he saw.

entities.name: Rip
entities.description: A spawn hunter.

entities.name: Henry
entities.description: A person whose doll was thrown away.

entities.name: Sarissa
entities.description: A woman possessed by a ghost.

entities.name: Taros
entities.description: A survivor who seized a weapon after his friends died.

entities.name: Sunrise
entities.description: A survivor sentry.

entities.name: Victor
entities.description: Valgavoth's seneschal.

entities.name: Lana
entities.description: A person who reached for Shay's hand in the dark.

entities.name: Shay
entities.description: A person who called to Lana from the next room.

entities.name: Maggie
entities.description: A person trapped in a screen.

entities.name: Cori
entities.description: A person whose unsettling doll kept returning.

entities.name: Arabella
entities.description: A doll that returns every morning to Cori's shelf.

entities.name: Marvin
entities.description: A puppet that once belonged to a razorkin and now hunts alone.

entities.name: Farley
entities.description: A track team runner who became undead.

entities.name: Vicky
entities.description: A woman who hears her grandmother's voice as she tires.

entities.name: Melinda
entities.description: A person guided by a ghost after a hundred years.

entities.name: Kona
entities.description: A rescue beastie.

entities.name: Angus
entities.description: A survivor scout.

events.summary: Kaito's blade brings the light of another plane into Duskmourn, giving a brief chance to escape.
events.quote: Kaito's blade brought the light of another plane into Duskmourn

events.summary: The Wanderer flings out her hand too late as Kaito vanishes into the House's maw.
events.quote: Kaito had vanished into the House's maw.

events.summary: Niko shatters the wickerfolk and whisks Nashi to safety.
events.quote: Niko shattered the wickerfolk and whisked Nashi to safety.

events.summary: Winter tells Niko that his way out is his own, leaving them to find theirs.
events.quote: This is my way out. You'll have to find your own.

events.summary: Niko and the Wanderer meet the stranger Winter, who is friendlier than the creature chasing them.
events.quote: I don't know," the Wanderer replied

events.summary: Tyvar and the Wanderer stop running from Valgavoth's onslaught.
events.quote: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

events.summary: Jace keeps his mouth shut in the presence of strange creatures.
Zimone and Tyvar's differing theories both prove right against the cultists.
Elsa steps over her friends' corpses after bargaining with a demon.
events.quote: Elsa swelled with euphoria and power as she stepped over her friends' corpses.

events.summary: Valgavoth whispers to Marina until she hears nothing else.
events.quote: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

events.summary: The ghost of an unnamed person possesses Sarissa.
events.quote: As the ghost clawed its way into her skin, Sarissa forgot

events.summary: Sasha fends off cellarspawn hordes with the essence of her pet hamster.
events.quote: At first Sasha felt silly fending off the cellarspawn hordes

relations.note: Toby is unafraid because Gribble is big.
relations.quote: Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared.
